segment.instructions: Which segment best describes this person, based on `role` and `signupAnswer`?

criteria.founder: Founder, co-founder, CEO, owner or managing director who runs the company
criteria.team_lead: Manager, head, director or team lead who leads a team or area inside a company
criteria.individual_contributor: Individual contributor: engineer, designer, analyst, marketer or specialist without a team
criteria.student: Student, intern, bootcamp learner or recent graduate looking for a first job
criteria.investor: Investor, venture capital partner, angel or fund manager

companyStage.instructions: What stage is the company in `company` at, given `companySize` and context?

criteria.idea: Idea or side project, no product or revenue yet, solo founder, freelance
criteria.early_stage: Early stage startup or small agency with first customers, pre-seed or seed, small team of 2-10 or 11-50
criteria.scale_up: Scale-up growing fast after product market fit, raised a round, series A or later, hiring, 51-200 people
criteria.corporate: Established corporate, enterprise, bank or large company with 201-1000 or 1000+ employees

aiMaturity.instructions: How mature is AI adoption in this person’s company?
criteria: Low: exploring, curious, no AI in use, wants to start or understand basics
Medium: some AI tools or pilots in use by a few people or teams
High: AI agents, models or automation in production, integrated in core workflows

salesReady.instructions: Is this person ready for a commercial conversation about a paid program now?

criteria.true: Has budget, a concrete need, a deadline, wants to implement or train their team now, attended several events, keeps visiting the program page
criteria.false: Only curious, browsing, networking, learning alone, student, no budget, inactive

wantsLearning.instructions: Is this person mainly looking to learn or train skills rather than to network?

criteria.true: Wants to learn, course, program, training, upskill, skills, certification, bootcamp
criteria.false: Wants networking, meet people, investors, deal flow, partners

decisionPower.instructions: Can this person decide or approve a purchase for their team or company?

criteria.true: Founder, CEO, owner, director, head, manager who leads a team and has budget
criteria.false: Student, intern, graduate, engineer, designer, analyst or specialist without a team

urgency.instructions: How urgent is this person’s need?
criteria: Low: curious, exploring, someday, no timeline, browsing
Medium: planning this year, comparing options, some interest
High: now, this quarter, deadline, budget assigned, raised a round, changed role, new position

fitsOffer.instructions: Does this person fit what 30X offers: AI events, programs and content for professionals and teams?

criteria.true: Wants to learn or apply AI, implement automation or AI agents, train a team, adopt AI at work, attended several events, keeps visiting the program page
criteria.false: Unrelated need, friend told me, no interest in AI, only selling something
